note: Fresh verification pass supersedes 2026-08-20 report. FR-008 and FR-010 re-classified from aligned to drifted (partial): the 2026-08-07 sweep filed align-tasks for them but no source change landed, so the MUST sub-clauses (destroy-failure logging; ibv_reg_mr->Registration mapping) remain unmet in the shipped --features rdma code. Load-bearing behavior of each FR is aligned; all three drifts are ALIGN and only reachable under --features rdma.

drifted.spec_text: Freeing the queue pair (rdma_destroy_qp) is best-effort cleanup performed after the ERROR transition; its failure MUST be logged, not fatal.
drifted.actual: Load-bearing part aligned: QP->ERROR asserted (fail-stop) before the ack; unknown/dead nodes acked idempotently (src/connection.rs:181-195, src/rdma.rs:144-152). But RealCmConn::drop ignores rdma_disconnect/rdma_destroy_qp/rdma_destroy_id return codes and logs nothing, so the 'its failure MUST be logged' clause is unmet.

drifted.spec_text: If the memory_tier receptacle is unbound, the pool is uninitialized, or ibv_reg_mr fails, initialize() MUST return Registration.
drifted.actual: Register-once/expose/dereg and the precondition Registration paths (unbound receptacle, uninitialized pool) are aligned (src/lib.rs:191-211). But RealCmSeam::bind returns Err(String) for all real-CM failures, mapped uniformly via .map_err(RemoteLookupRdmaResponderError::Bind) at src/lib.rs:203, so a genuine ibv_reg_mr failure surfaces as Bind not Registration.

drifted.spec_text: Diagnostics MUST route through an optional ILogger receptacle; a missing logger MUST NOT turn any operation into an error.
drifted.actual: Primary diagnostics route through ILogger via log_debug and tolerate a missing logger (aligned, src/lib.rs:116-120). But device async-event instrumentation prints via eprintln!, bypassing ILogger. Documented in spec Known Limitations with a tracked align-task.

unspecced.feature: Device async-event instrumentation (TAG_ASYNC epoll fd, drain_async_events, async_event_name, FFI responder_async_fd/responder_drain_async_event)
unspecced.suggested_spec: Already documented in spec Known Limitations (backfilled 2026-08-07); best-effort operator diagnostics, no FR needed unless it becomes load-bearing.

unspecced.feature: Command-bridge thread (rdma-responder-cmd-bridge) draining the SPSC command inbox onto the command eventfd
unspecced.suggested_spec: Already documented in spec.md FR-004 note + data-model (backfilled 2026-08-20). FR-004 SPSC->eventfd mechanism; no FR promotion.
